evidence.detail: No /people/tournament/ route exists; only /people/ and /people/<mtgo_username>/ are registered under SEASONS
load_people() has no deck_type parameter; SQL aggregates all decks without filtering by source/competition type
Author noted 'Things like head-to-head and unique-cards-played would need some work', confirming known sub-feature complexity beyond the listing page itself

triage.notes: Would require: new route in people.py controller, a deck_type param added to load_people() with a WHERE clause filtering by competition_id IS NOT NULL (for tournament) or source (for league), and the People view updated to show the filter. Sub-pages like head-to-head and unique cards would still need further work per the author's own comment.
